text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear anti-driverless thesis in opening and conclusion","quality":"stance control","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps that position consistent through the essay."},{"evidence":"\"If the human driver will need to take control...\" and \"this additional feature... adds unneeded complications\"","quality":"analysis","description":"It explains why the cited details matter instead of only repeating information from the article."},{"evidence":"paragraph on entertainment being \"overly complex and would most likely cost a lot of money\"","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It develops a cause-and-effect argument about why the technology would be a burden rather than just a convenience."},{"evidence":"\"Overall, driverless cars would not benefit our lives enough to invest a lot in this field\"","quality":"conclusion strength","description":"It ends by restating and synthesizing the argument in a clear, decisive way."},{"evidence":"references to \"driverless cars aren't truly driverless\" and \"lack motivation for the driver to stay alert\"","quality":"focus","description":"It stays centered on a few main objections and builds them repeatedly instead of scattering attention across many loosely connected claims."}]}
